title: Boston Scientific Announces FDA Approval and First U.S. Implant of New Devices To Treat Bradycardia
关键词: LATITUDE™ NXT Remote Patient Management system
主要内容: Boston Scientific Corporation (NYSE: BSX) received FDA approval for the INGENIO™ and ADVANTIO™ pacemakers and INVIVE™ cardiac resynchronization therapy pacemakers (CRT-P). The first implant of these devices in the U.S. was performed on May 3 by Bruce L. Wilkoff, M.D., Director of Cardiac Pacing and Tachyarrhythmia Devices at the Cleveland Clinic. These devices feature RightRate™ pacing technology to treat chronotropic incompetence (CI), a condition where the heart fails to regulate its rate during physical activity. The technology includes a minute ventilation (MV) sensor, the only clinically proven sensor to restore chronotropic competence. The approval marks a new era in pacing technology for the company's bradycardia business. The devices are designed for use with the LATITUDE™ NXT Remote Patient Management system, currently under FDA review.
